profilebegin() -> false | "debug.profilebegin(string) parameter must be string, got an unexpected type. Not opening profile block."
profilebegin(1) -> true
profilebegin(true) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'profilebegin' (string expected, got boolean)"
profilebegin({}) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'profilebegin' (string expected, got table)"
profilebegin('a') -> true
profileend() -> true
profileend() again -> true
setmemorycategory('a') -> true
setmemorycategory('b') returns previous -> true | "a"
getmemorycategory -> true | "b"
setmemorycategory(1) -> true | "b"
getmemorycategory number tag -> true | "1"
setmemorycategory() -> false | "missing argument #1 to 'setmemorycategory' (string expected)"
setmemorycategory(nil) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'setmemorycategory' (string expected, got nil)"
resetmemorycategory -> true
getmemorycategory after reset -> true | "1"
synchronize() -> false | "task.synchronize() may only be called from a script that is a descendant of an Actor"
desynchronize() -> false | "task.desynchronize() may only be called from a script that is a descendant of an Actor"
fromExisting() -> false | "missing argument #1 to 'fromExisting' (Instance expected)"
fromExisting(1) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'fromExisting' (Instance expected, got number)"
fromExisting(nil) -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'fromExisting' (Instance expected, got nil)"
fromExisting('Part') -> false | "invalid argument #1 to 'fromExisting' (Instance expected, got string)"
fromExisting(workspace) -> false | "Unable to create an Instance of type \"Workspace\""
fromExisting(game) -> false | "Unable to create an Instance of type \"DataModel\""
fromExisting(Players) -> false | "Unable to create an Instance of type \"Players\""
copy keeps properties, drops children and parent -> true | "Orig|true|1, 2, 3|5|children=0|parent=nil|tag=true|same=false"
Archivable false still copies -> true | "Origfalse"
Clone with Archivable false is nil -> true | "nil"
extra args ignored -> true | "Orig"
script class -> true | "ScriptS"
debug.info on the new members -> true | "[C],[C],[C],[C],[C]"
